    <!-- MODULE 5 — Kitesurf stays (ultra-clean) -->
<section class="rv-wrap" id="kite-stays" style="margin-top:18px">
  <div class="rv-card rv-pad">
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Kitesurf Kalpitiya Accommodation — Calm Base, Great Sessions</h2>
    <p class="rv-sub">
      If you want a <strong>kite camp in Kalpitiya, Sri Lanka</strong> vibe — but with quieter nights — Ruuk Village is a strong fit.
      Stay by the lagoon, add gear rental, and plan sessions around wind and recovery.
      Many guests love the <strong>sunset lagoon bungalow Kalpitiya</strong> feeling: ride, rinse, eat, and switch off.
    </p>
    <!-- Stay + Lessons bridge (single contextual link, no CTA clutter) -->
    <p class="rv-p" style="margin-top:14px">
      Many of our guests combine their stay with
      <a class="rv-link" href="/kitesurfing-school-sri-lanka">
        kite lessons at Ruuk Village
      </a>,
      enjoying a calm learning environment without crowds.
    </p>
    <div class="rv-grid rv-grid-2" style="margin-top:14px">
      <!-- Card 1 -->
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">
        <h3 class="rv-h3">Progression Stay</h3>
        <p class="rv-p rv-mini">
          Built for riders who want steady lagoon sessions, simple logistics and a comfortable base.
        </p>
        <ul class="rv-list">
          <li><strong>Comfortable mid-range cabanas</strong> for proper recovery</li>
          <li><strong>Wind guidance</strong> for your dates and level</li>

    <!-- MODULE 8 — FAQ -->
<section class="rv-wrap" id="faq" style="margin-top:18px">
  <div class="rv-card rv-pad">
    <h2 class="rv-h2">FAQ: Staying in Kalpitiya</h2>
    <div class="rv-faq" style="margin-top:12px">
      <details>
        <summary>Where is the best area to stay for kiting / kitesurfing in Sri Lanka?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Kalpitiya is the only place in Sri Lanka with reliable wind. Therefore the only kitesurf regions are found within the 40km strech of the Kalpitiya Penisula and island spots.
          Staying on the banks of the main kiting lagoon of Kalpitiya  makes it easy for students, since there is no jeep or truck involvedd but a picturustic boat ride across the lagoon. And you can also do your first down winder back to the other side with the sunset.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Is Ruuk Village a kite camp or an eco lodge?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Ruuk Village is eco-friendly accommodation that works perfectly for kitesurfers.
          You can add gear rental fromthe Ruuk Village kiteschool and organize island sessions while still enjoying a quiet, nature-based stay. Where you are able to Disconnect, Reflect and Reconnect
        </div>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Do you offer transfers to kite spots in Kalpitiya?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Yes we do, depending on the spot and season, we help organize boat or tuk-tuk logistics.
          Many island sessions are reached by boat, and the boat leaves our entrance and we’ll guide you on the easiest plan for your dates.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>What’s the best time for kitesurfing in Kalpitiya?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Typically May–September is the main kitesurf season (strong wind). December–March often brings lighter winds, ideal for progression and relaxed riding. 
        </div>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Is this accommodation suitable for non kitesurfers too?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Absolutely. Many guests come for the lagoon, dolphins, SUP, cycling, nature trips, or simply to unwind.
          Ruuk Village is built for slow travel, and to empower the locals. kitesurfing is optional. 
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
